source_snapshot.items: BMC I2C-15 to UPHY3 from first PG548
source_snapshot.procedure: On BMC scan bus14 then `i2ctransfer -y 14 w3@0x44 0xc0 0x0 0x0 r4`; PID1114953.
source_snapshot.criteria: Collect evidence/photos and check logs; no instance or four-byte oracle.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Flags bus/register risk but keeps physical acceptance and leaves first-PG548 attribution undecoded.

old_problem: BMC I2C-15-to-bus14 mapping, first-PG548 UPHY3-at0x44 identity,0xc00000 semantics/four-byte decoder, ownership, error criteria and recovery are absent; second-PG548 uses the same tuple.
disposition_reason: The exact remote read is a valid functional candidate, not Manual Only, but ED-02/03 require response binding to the first PG548 and an OEM four-byte oracle. The identical second-PG548 address/register path cannot substitute for this variant.
decision_basis: Read XLSX row142, same-row AI fields and history2530; unique identity confirmed.
Preserved bus14,0x44,0xc00000,r4 and first-PG548 UPHY3 coverage.
Explicitly excluded row135 second-PG548 evidence and required first-instance telemetry.
Rejected blind scan, physical-only work, register guess, retry, reset and DUT action.

test_case.test_name: BMC I2C-15 to first-PG548 UPHY3 functional read
test_case.purpose: Prove BMC I2C-15 reaches UPHY3 on the first PG548 using one decoded, instance-bound read.
required_package: 0xc00000 non-mutating pointer semantics and four-byte decoder
test_case.test_command: Do not broad-scan. After identity/protocol approval, capture first-PG548/UPHY identity, owner and errors; execute one `i2ctransfer -y 14 w3@0x44 0xc0 0x0 0x0 r4`; decode all bytes, correlate first-instance telemetry, prove second-PG548 evidence was not used and do not retry.
test_case.expected_result: Exactly four bytes match the installed first-PG548 UPHY3 oracle, path telemetry remains clean and management health is unchanged.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires first-instance mapping/identity and decoded expected fields. ACK/raw bytes, second-instance substitution, wrong length/value, NACK/timeout/arbitration loss or new UPHY/BMC error fails.
safety_gate: Confirm bus14/0x44 first-instance identity and0xc00000 read semantics.
Coordinate bus owner; no broad scan or concurrent access.
One bounded request; preserve first failure and stop without retry/reset.
Do not use row135 evidence or probe/solder as a substitute.
expected_evidence: First-instance pre/post errors, health, non-substitution proof and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: The approved read should be state-neutral. Preserve evidence and stop on anomaly; use only the approved BMC/UPHY recovery path.

source_conflict.reason: First-instance mapping, target/register identity and response oracle are absent; prior reviews add unsourced physical work.

blocked.reason: The bounded request is clear; OEM mapping/decoder and ownership are resolvable RPUC inputs.

pending.execution_status: ENGINEERING DECISION RETAINED; REQUIRES CONFIRMATION; NO DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.unlock_condition: Approve first-instance mapping and register oracle plus recovery, then revise the record.
